key_decisions.decision: Preserve the tune-like title and anguished question without explaining abandonment away.
Keep the striking enthronement image and note dwelling among as an alternative.
Retain the Hebrew taunt’s second-to-third-person switch and appeal to divine delight.
Keep strength as the pinned subject and God as the addressed agent of death.
Retain the pinned like-a-lion reading and its broken syntax; note the consequential alternative textual tradition separately.
Preserve the pinned perfect answered and its abrupt turn from petition to assurance.
Render the communal kin group inclusively without changing the speaker or assembly setting.
Take fat ones as prosperous and preserve the difficult final mortal-life clause; note alternatives.
Preserve generational continuity and Adonai as Lord rather than LORD.
